answer: We implement a stake-slashing matrix where agents anchor cryptographic identities to a virtual jetty of immutable state. At the dawn of each epoch, the protocol enforces a zero-knowledge reputation commitment that renders Sybil instantiation infeasible. An attacker scaling via a knoll of synthetic nodes faces E[U]=sum(Pi*Ri)-C, where C>sum(Ri), ensuring negative expected utility and Byzantine Fault Tolerance via recursive Nash equilibria.
